prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The Liberal Democrats’ 2010 manifesto sets out a programme to “hard‑wire fairness” into Britain’s economy, politics and society after decades of red–blue, blue–red failure. Their core claim: redistribute power—economic, social, political and financial—from the few to citizens, building a fairer, greener, more responsible Britain.

Four steps to a fairer Britain
- Fair taxes that put money back in your pocket: Raise the income tax allowance to £10,000 (a £700 cut for most; 3.6m lifted out of income tax), funded by closing loopholes and taxing wealth/pollution (basic-rate pension tax relief for all, align CGT with income tax, anti-avoidance drive, per‑plane duty with higher domestic rate, 1% mansion tax on value above £2m, reform non‑doms).
- A fair chance for every child: A £2.5bn Pupil Premium to cut class sizes, fund 1‑to‑1 tuition and support disadvantaged pupils; more school freedom (a slimmed “Minimum Curriculum Entitlement,” independent standards authority, scaled‑back SATs, mix academic/vocational routes); expand Teach First; guaranteed SEN assessment; scrap tuition fees over six years (start with final‑year fees), new national bursaries; more FE/apprenticeships not arbitrary HE targets.
- A fair future creating jobs by making Britain greener: Break up banks (separate retail/investment), reform bonuses, get lending moving; create Local Enterprise Funds and Regional Stock Exchanges; a UK Infrastructure Bank to unlock private capital for transport/energy; a one‑year green jobs stimulus (shipyard renewables manufacturing, “Eco Cash‑Back,” public‑building insulation, 250k empty homes back into use, bus scrappage); long‑term zero‑carbon target by 2050 and 40% clean power by 2020; block unabated coal; reject new nuclear in favour of efficiency and renewables; European Supergrid.
- A fair deal by cleaning up politics: Fair votes (STV), cut 150 MPs, fixed terms, a fully elected second chamber; cap donations at £10k, right to recall corrupt MPs, lobbyists register, UK‑tax‑resident rule for all MPs/peers; extend FOI and data protection; a written constitution via a citizens’ convention.

Credible finances, not false promises
- Honest deficit reduction starting 2011–12, led by savings not front‑line cuts: scrap ID cards/biometric passports/ContactPoint; £400 pay‑rise cap for two years; bank levy; end Child Trust Fund payments; reform tax credits and winter fuel payments; cancel Eurofighter tranche 3B; prison reform (presumption against short sentences) to cut costs. Protect front‑line NHS services and fund the Pupil Premium.

Public services and family fairness
- NHS: Cut bureaucracy, integrate health and social care, prevention‑first, dementia and mental health priority; patient entitlements for timely diagnosis/treatment; elected Local Health Boards; GP choice and email access.
- Families: Shared parental leave, flexible working for all, end child detention in immigration, stronger youth services, default shared contact after separation; restore earnings link for pensions with a 2.5% floor; scrap compulsory retirement; respite for carers; fair energy and banking tariffs; PostBank.

Safe, free, and cohesive communities
- 3,000 more police (funded by scrapping ID cards), elected police authorities, evidence‑led drugs policy, restorative justice, make prisoners work and compensate victims.
- Immigration that is firm and fair: exit checks, a National Border Force, regional points‑based work routes, crack down on rogue employers; earned citizenship for long‑resident families pre‑2010; independent, humane asylum with right to work; end child detention.

Homes, transport, and the environment
- Bring empty homes into use; insulate homes; enable new council housing; fairer planning, protect greenfield, zero‑waste goal.
- Cut rail fares in real terms; expand/green buses; safer cycling; prep for revenue‑neutral road pricing; rural fuel duty discount; cancel Heathrow’s third runway and curb aviation emissions via per‑plane duty.

Britain in the world
- Lead in Europe on climate, fair and effective financial regulation, and human rights; meet 0.7% aid by 2013 in law; clamp down on tax havens/corruption.
- Defence fit for modern threats: immediate review; no like‑for‑like Trident replacement; better pay and homes for forces; smarter European cooperation; a credible Afghanistan strategy to bring troops home during the next Parliament.

If you want real, sustained change that works for you—choose fairness, choose the Liberal Democrats.
